figmaComponent: Radio button item / Radio button / Radiobutton Group

valueMap.state.mouseon|animation.mouseon: :focus-visible（本地状态名 focus，Figma 源属性值仍为 mouseon）
valueMap.align.vertical: vertical（2026-09-10 起 Figma 直接产出该值，见 RAD-002）
valueMap.align.verticle: vertical（历史拼写兼容映射，Figma 侧已修正为 vertical，此项暂保留兼容旧实例/缓存）

tokenMap.mousedown: radio-pc-pressed.svg + radio-pc-press-ring.svg (transient press effect asset; see RAD-003)
tokenMap.typography.figma: 中文/S8-CN-R（2026-09-10 起，此前为 Body_14px_regular）
tokenMap.typography.currentEquivalent: 中文/S8-CN-R（RAD-001 已关闭，Figma 侧已直接改绑，此字段保留作为代码侧字体体系锚点）

interactionMap.focus: :focus-visible (2026-09-08 设计确认由 mouseon 重命名为 focus，保留独立 20px 光晕，不与 hover 合并；见 RAD-004)
interactionMap.mousedown: transient :active press animation on pointer-down, not a persisted style; plays briefly on the option being pressed and settles into that option's resulting checked/unchecked appearance on release — 2026-09-08 设计确认, see RAD-003

accessibility.group: all mutually exclusive options share one name; use fieldset/legend for a titled group
accessibility.selection: exactly one checked value per group
accessibility.keyboard: Arrow keys move selection within the group; Space selects the focused option
